description: This file defines in-memory repository classes and related utilities for managing draft objects, including creation, retrieval, validation, and approval workflows within the API backend. It also contains a no-operation audit log repository.

classes.name: DraftRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a stored draft with additional workflow state.

classes.name: InMemoryDraftRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing in-memory storage and management of draft records for testing purposes.

classes.name: NoOpAuditLogRepository
classes.description: Implementation of a no-operation audit logging repository that conforms to AuditRepoProtocol, used as fallback.

methods.name: DraftRecord create_draft(self, *, draft_id: str, submitted_by: str, submission: DraftSubmissionRequest)
methods.description: Creates and stores a new draft record with specified draft ID, submitter, and submission data.

methods.name: Optional[DraftRecord] get(self, draft_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a draft record by draft ID if it exists.

methods.name: DraftRecord ensure_exists_for_tests(self, draft_id: str, *, submitter_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Ensures a draft with given ID exists; creates a placeholder if it does not.

methods.name: str next_draft_id(self)
methods.description: Generates a new unique draft ID.

methods.name: None mark_validation(self, draft_id: str, *, passed: bool, report_version: str)
methods.description: Updates the draft's validation status and report version.

methods.name: None mark_approved(self, draft_id: str, *, approved: bool)
